source.text: וּכְהִתְפַּלֵּ֤ל עֶזְרָא֙ וּכְ֨הִתְוַדֹּת֔וֹבֹּכֶה֙ וּמִתְנַפֵּ֔ל לִפְנֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים נִקְבְּצוּ֩ אֵלָ֨יו מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֜ל קָהָ֣ל רַב־מְאֹ֗ד אֲנָשִׁ֤ים וְנָשִׁים֙ וִֽילָדִ֔ים כִּֽי־בָכ֥וּ הָעָ֖ם הַרְבֵּה־בֶֽכֶה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And as prayed Ezra and as he confessed, weeping and throwing himself down before [the] house of God, gathered to him from Israel an assembly great very, men and women and children, for wept the people [a] great weeping.

en.L: And as Ezra prayed and as he confessed, weeping and throwing himself down before the house of God, a very great assembly gathered to him from Israel, men and women and children, for the people wept [with] much weeping.
en.B: While Ezra was praying and confessing, weeping and throwing himself down before the house of God, a very large assembly of men, women, and children from Israel gathered around him, and the people wept bitterly.
en.R: Ezra was praying and confessing the people's sins. He was crying and lying face down in front of God's temple. While he did this, a very large crowd of Israelites gathered around him: men, women, and children. They were all crying hard.

es.L: Y mientras Esdras oraba y confesaba, llorando y postrándose delante de la casa de Dios, se reunió en torno a él una asamblea muy grande de Israel, hombres y mujeres y niños, porque el pueblo lloraba [con] gran llanto.
es.B: Mientras Esdras oraba y confesaba, llorando y postrado delante de la casa de Dios, se reunió a su alrededor una asamblea muy grande de hombres, mujeres y niños de Israel, y el pueblo lloraba amargamente.
es.R: Esdras oraba y confesaba los pecados del pueblo. Lloraba y estaba tendido en el suelo, con el rostro en tierra, delante del templo de Dios. Mientras hacía esto, una multitud muy grande de israelitas se reunió a su alrededor: hombres, mujeres y niños. Todos lloraban mucho.

sw.L: Na Ezra alipokuwa akiomba na alipokuwa akiungama, akilia na kujitupa chini mbele ya nyumba ya Mungu, kusanyiko kubwa sana kutoka Israeli likakusanyika kwake, wanaume na wanawake na watoto, kwa maana watu walilia kilio kikuu.
sw.B: Ezra alipokuwa akiomba na kuungama, akilia na kujitupa chini mbele ya nyumba ya Mungu, kusanyiko kubwa sana la wanaume, wanawake na watoto kutoka Israeli lilikusanyika kumzunguka, na watu walilia kwa uchungu.
sw.R: Ezra alikuwa akiomba na kuungama dhambi za watu. Alikuwa akilia na kulala kifudifudi mbele ya hekalu la Mungu. Alipokuwa akifanya hivyo, umati mkubwa sana wa Waisraeli ulikusanyika kumzunguka: wanaume, wanawake na watoto. Wote walikuwa wakilia sana.

decisions.choice: Ezra prayed: the account now speaks of Ezra as "he", not "I"
decisions.reason: From 7:27 to 9:15 Ezra tells his story in the first person. Chapter 10 goes on with the same events but calls him "Ezra" and "he", as the book did in 7:1-11. The change of voice does not change the events: the prayer of 9:6-15 is the prayer meant here.

decisions.choice: confessed, throwing himself down: confessing the people's sin while lying on the ground
decisions.reason: The verb for confess is the one used for confessing sin over the sacrifice on the Day of Atonement (Leviticus 16:21) and in the prayers of Nehemiah 1:6 and 9:2-3. The second verb means to throw oneself down full length, as Moses did when he prayed for the people (Deuteronomy 9:18, 25).

decisions.choice: a very great assembly: a large gathering of the people
decisions.reason: The word is the one used for Israel gathered as a community. The crowd gathers of its own accord before the formal assembly of verses 7-9, and it includes women and children, whose families are at stake.

decisions.choice: lying face down; God's temple; a very large crowd (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable describes the posture, uses the book-wide wording for the house of God, and calls the gathering a crowd, since it has not yet been formally called together.

decisions.choice: Ezra in the third person ("Esdras oraba") at every level
decisions.reason: The account turns from Ezra's own "I" (7:27-9:15) to "Esdras" and "él", as the Hebrew does (m1); Spanish follows it at every level.

source.text: וַיַּעַן֩ שְׁכַנְיָ֨ה בֶן־יְחִיאֵ֜ל מִבְּנֵ֤י עֵילָם֙ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לְעֶזְרָ֔א אֲנַ֨חְנוּ֙ מָעַ֣לְנוּ בֵאלֹהֵ֔ינוּ וַנֹּ֛שֶׁב נָשִׁ֥ים נָכְרִיּ֖וֹת מֵעַמֵּ֣י הָאָ֑רֶץ וְעַתָּ֛ה יֵשׁ־מִקְוֶ֥ה לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַל־זֹֽאת׃

records.literal_gloss: And answered Shecaniah son of Jehiel, of [the] sons of Elam, and said to Ezra, We, we have acted unfaithfully against our God, and we have settled women foreign from [the] peoples of the land; and now there is hope for Israel concerning this.

en.L: And Shecaniah son of Jehiel, of the sons of Elam, answered and said to Ezra, "We have been unfaithful to our God and have married foreign women from the peoples of the land, yet now there is hope for Israel concerning this.
en.B: Then Shecaniah son of Jehiel, one of the descendants of Elam, spoke up and said to Ezra, "We have been unfaithful to our God by marrying foreign wives from the peoples of the land. But even so, there is still hope for Israel.
en.R: Then Shecaniah son of Jehiel, from the family of Elam, said to Ezra, "We have been unfaithful to our God. We married foreign wives from the people living in the land. But even now there is still hope for Israel.

es.L: Y respondió Secanías hijo de Jehiel, de los hijos de Elam, y dijo a Esdras: «Nosotros hemos sido infieles a nuestro Dios y hemos tomado mujeres extranjeras de los pueblos de la tierra; pero ahora hay esperanza para Israel en cuanto a esto.
es.B: Entonces Secanías hijo de Jehiel, uno de los descendientes de Elam, tomó la palabra y le dijo a Esdras: «Hemos sido infieles a nuestro Dios al casarnos con esposas extranjeras de los pueblos de la tierra. Pero aun así, todavía hay esperanza para Israel.
es.R: Entonces Secanías hijo de Jehiel, de la familia de Elam, le dijo a Esdras: «Hemos sido infieles a nuestro Dios. Nos casamos con esposas extranjeras de la gente que vive en el país. Pero aun ahora todavía hay esperanza para Israel.

sw.L: Na Shekania mwana wa Yehieli, wa wana wa Elamu, akajibu, akamwambia Ezra, "Sisi tumemwasi Mungu wetu, nasi tumeoa wanawake wageni kutoka mataifa ya nchi; lakini sasa liko tumaini kwa Israeli kuhusu jambo hili.
sw.B: Ndipo Shekania mwana wa Yehieli, mmoja wa wazao wa Elamu, alisema, akamwambia Ezra, "Tumekosa uaminifu kwa Mungu wetu kwa kuoa wake wageni kutoka mataifa ya nchi. Hata hivyo bado liko tumaini kwa Israeli.
sw.R: Kisha Shekania mwana wa Yehieli, wa jamaa ya Elamu, akamwambia Ezra, "Tumekosa uaminifu kwa Mungu wetu. Tumeoa wake wageni kutoka kwa watu walioishi katika nchi. Lakini hata sasa bado liko tumaini kwa Israeli.

decisions.choice: Elam: the reading the scribes marked
decisions.reason: The consonants written in the text (ketiv) can be read "Olam"; the reading the scribes marked (qere) is "Elam", the family named in 2:7, 8:7 and 10:26. The two differ by one letter, and Elam is the name meant.

decisions.choice: Shecaniah son of Jehiel: perhaps the son of one of the offenders
decisions.reason: A Jehiel of the descendants of Elam is listed among the men who had married foreign wives (10:26). If he is Shecaniah's father, Shecaniah is proposing a step that will touch his own family. The name is common, so this is not certain.

decisions.choice: we have married foreign women: literally, we have settled foreign women (in our homes)
decisions.reason: The verb means to cause to dwell or give a home to. In this sense, for marrying, it is used only here and in Nehemiah 13:23, 27. The women are foreign in the sense of belonging to the other peoples of the land, not to the returned community.

decisions.choice: the sons of Elam (Literal), the descendants of Elam (Balanced), the family of Elam (Readable); foreign women (Literal), foreign wives (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: These follow the book-wide wording for family names in the lists and for the foreign wives.

decisions.choice: "mujeres extranjeras" (L); "esposas extranjeras" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's wording for the foreign wives (1 Kings 11:1, 8), used through chapter 10.

decisions.choice: "wanawake wageni" (L), "wake wageni" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The terms-note wording for the foreign wives, through chapter 10.

source.text: וְעַתָּ֣ה נִֽכְרָת־בְּרִ֣ית לֵ֠אלֹהֵינוּ לְהוֹצִ֨יא כָל־נָשִׁ֜ים וְהַנּוֹלָ֤ד מֵהֶם֙ בַּעֲצַ֣ת אֲדֹנָ֔י וְהַחֲרֵדִ֖ים בְּמִצְוַ֣ת אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וְכַתּוֹרָ֖ה יֵעָשֶֽׂה׃

records.literal_gloss: And now let us cut a covenant with our God to send out all [the] wives and the [one] born from them, by [the] counsel of [the] Lord and the trembling at [the] commandment of our God; and according to [the] law let it be done.

en.L: So now let us make a covenant with our God to send away all the wives and those born from them, according to the counsel of the Lord and of those who tremble at the commandment of our God; and let it be done according to the law.
en.B: So now let us make a covenant with our God to send away all these wives and their children, following the counsel of the Lord and of those who tremble at the commandment of our God. Let it be done according to the law.
en.R: Let us make a covenant with our God now. We will send away all these wives and their children. We will follow the advice of the Lord and of the people who take God's commands seriously. Let us do what the law says.

es.L: Ahora, pues, hagamos un pacto con nuestro Dios de despedir a todas las mujeres y a los nacidos de ellas, conforme al consejo del Señor y de los que tiemblan ante el mandamiento de nuestro Dios; y hágase conforme a la ley.
es.B: Así que ahora hagamos un pacto con nuestro Dios de despedir a todas estas esposas y a sus hijos, siguiendo el consejo del Señor y de los que tiemblan ante el mandamiento de nuestro Dios. Que se haga conforme a la ley.
es.R: Hagamos ahora un pacto con nuestro Dios. Despediremos a todas estas esposas y a sus hijos. Seguiremos el consejo del Señor y de la gente que toma en serio los mandamientos de Dios. Hagamos lo que dice la ley.

sw.L: Basi sasa na tufanye agano na Mungu wetu kuwafukuza wake wote na waliozaliwa nao, sawasawa na shauri la Bwana na la wale wanaotetemeka kwa amri ya Mungu wetu; na ifanyike sawasawa na sheria.
sw.B: Basi sasa na tufanye agano na Mungu wetu la kuwaondoa wake hao wote na watoto wao, tukifuata shauri la Bwana na la wale wanaotetemeka kwa amri ya Mungu wetu. Na lifanyike sawasawa na sheria.
sw.R: Na tufanye agano na Mungu wetu sasa. Tutawaondoa wake hao wote pamoja na watoto wao. Tutafuata shauri la Bwana na la watu wanaozichukua kwa uzito amri za Mungu. Na tufanye kama sheria inavyosema.

decisions.choice: let us cut a covenant: let us make a solemn binding agreement
decisions.reason: "Cutting" a covenant is the usual Hebrew way of saying it was made, perhaps from the animals cut in two when a covenant was sealed (Genesis 15:9-18; Jeremiah 34:18). The people bind themselves before God, as they do again in Nehemiah 10:1.

decisions.choice: send away the wives and those born from them: dissolve the marriages, with the children going with their mothers
decisions.reason: To send a wife out is to divorce her (compare Deuteronomy 24:1-2, which uses a related verb). "The wives" are the foreign wives of verse 2. The children go with their mothers, which was usual where a marriage ended.

decisions.choice: the counsel of the Lord, or of my lord
decisions.reason: The vowels of the received text read the word as "the Lord", that is, God. The same consonants can be read "my lord", a polite way of addressing Ezra; that reading fits the pairing with "those who tremble" and the "counsel of the leaders" in verse 8. The translation follows the vowels of the received text.

decisions.choice: according to the law: as the law of Moses requires
decisions.reason: The law forbade marriage with the peoples of the land (Deuteronomy 7:3) and set rules for sending a wife away (Deuteronomy 24:1-4). Shecaniah asks that what is done be done in line with the law, which Ezra had been sent to teach (7:10, 25).

decisions.choice: all these wives (Balanced, Readable); the people who take God's commands seriously (Readable)
decisions.reason: "These" makes clear that the foreign wives of verse 2 are meant, not all wives. Readable explains trembling at the commandment as in 9:4.

decisions.choice: "del Señor"
decisions.reason: The vowels of the received text read *Adonai*, the Lord (m3), not the divine name, so it is "el Señor" without the divine_name setting.

decisions.choice: "Bwana" for Adonai, with no divine_name span
decisions.reason: The word here is Adonai, not the divine name, so it is written "Bwana"; the meaning decision notes the reading "my lord".

source.text: ק֛וּם כִּֽי־עָלֶ֥יךָ הַדָּבָ֖ר וַאֲנַ֣חְנוּ עִמָּ֑ךְ חֲזַ֖ק וַעֲשֵֽׂה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: Arise, for on you [is] the matter, and we [are] with you; be strong and act.

en.L: Arise, for the matter [is] on you, and we [are] with you; be strong and act."
en.B: Get up, for this matter is your responsibility, and we are with you. Be strong and do it."
en.R: Get up! It is your job to deal with this, and we will support you. Be brave and do it."

es.L: Levántate, porque a ti [te toca] el asunto, y nosotros [estamos] contigo; esfuérzate y actúa».
es.B: Levántate, porque este asunto es responsabilidad tuya, y nosotros estamos contigo. Sé fuerte y hazlo».
es.R: ¡Levántate! Te toca a ti encargarte de esto, y nosotros te apoyaremos. Ten valor y hazlo».

sw.L: Inuka, kwa maana jambo hili [ni] juu yako, nasi [tu] pamoja nawe; uwe hodari, ukatende."
sw.B: Inuka, kwa maana jambo hili ni jukumu lako, nasi tuko pamoja nawe. Uwe hodari ulitekeleze."
sw.R: Inuka! Ni kazi yako kulishughulikia jambo hili, nasi tutakuunga mkono. Uwe jasiri ulifanye."

decisions.choice: the matter is on you: it is your responsibility
decisions.reason: Ezra had been sent by the king to teach the law and to appoint judges to enforce it (7:25-26), so the people look to him to act.

decisions.choice: be strong and act: words of encouragement for a hard task
decisions.reason: David spoke the same words to Solomon about building the temple (1 Chronicles 28:10, 20).

source.text: וַיָּ֣קָם עֶזְרָ֡א וַיַּשְׁבַּ֣ע אֶת־שָׂרֵי֩ הַכֹּהֲנִ֨ים הַלְוִיִּ֜ם וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לַעֲשׂ֛וֹת כַּדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּ֖ה וַיִּשָּׁבֵֽעוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And arose Ezra and made swear the princes of the priests, the Levites, and all Israel to do according to the word this; and they swore.

en.L: And Ezra arose and made the princes of the priests, the Levites, and all Israel swear to do according to this word; and they swore.
en.B: So Ezra got up and made the leading priests and Levites and all Israel take an oath to do what had been proposed. And they took the oath.
en.R: So Ezra got up. He made the leaders of the priests and the Levites and all the people of Israel promise with an oath to do what Shecaniah had said. And they made that promise.

es.L: Y se levantó Esdras e hizo jurar a los jefes de los sacerdotes, de los levitas y de todo Israel que harían conforme a esta palabra; y juraron.
es.B: Entonces Esdras se levantó e hizo que los principales sacerdotes y levitas y todo Israel juraran hacer lo que se había propuesto. Y ellos lo juraron.
es.R: Entonces Esdras se levantó. Hizo que los jefes de los sacerdotes y de los levitas y todo el pueblo de Israel prometieran con juramento hacer lo que Secanías había dicho. Y ellos lo prometieron.

sw.L: Ndipo Ezra akainuka, akawaapisha wakuu wa makuhani, Walawi na Israeli wote kwamba watafanya sawasawa na neno hili; nao wakaapa.
sw.B: Basi Ezra aliinuka, akawaapisha makuhani viongozi, Walawi na Israeli wote kwamba watafanya kama ilivyopendekezwa. Nao wakaapa.
sw.R: Basi Ezra aliinuka. Aliwaagiza viongozi wa makuhani, Walawi na watu wote wa Israeli waahidi kwa kiapo kwamba watafanya kama Shekania alivyosema. Nao wakaahidi hivyo.

decisions.choice: the princes of the priests, the Levites, and all Israel: the leaders of the three groups
decisions.reason: "The princes" most likely governs all three: the heads of the priests, of the Levites, and of the people. The oath binds the community through its leaders.

decisions.choice: made them swear: an oath taken in God's name
decisions.reason: An oath called on God as witness and judge of anyone who broke it (Nehemiah 10:30; 13:25). It gives the covenant Shecaniah proposed its binding force.

decisions.choice: what had been proposed (Balanced), what Shecaniah had said (Readable)
decisions.reason: "This word" points to Shecaniah's proposal in verses 2-4; Balanced and Readable say so.

source.text: וַיָּ֣קָם עֶזְרָ֗א מִלִּפְנֵי֙ בֵּ֣ית הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים וַיֵּ֕לֶךְ אֶל־לִשְׁכַּ֖ת יְהוֹחָנָ֣ן בֶּן־אֶלְיָשִׁ֑יב וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ שָׁ֗ם לֶ֤חֶם לֹֽא־אָכַל֙ וּמַ֣יִם לֹֽא־שָׁתָ֔ה כִּ֥י מִתְאַבֵּ֖ל עַל־מַ֥עַל הַגּוֹלָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And rose Ezra from before [the] house of God and went to [the] chamber of Jehohanan son of Eliashib; and he went there; bread not he ate and water not he drank, for he was mourning over the unfaithfulness of the exile.

en.L: And Ezra rose from before the house of God and went to the chamber of Jehohanan son of Eliashib, and he went there; he ate no bread and drank no water, for he was mourning over the unfaithfulness of the exile.
en.B: Then Ezra left his place before the house of God and went to the room of Jehohanan son of Eliashib. He went there, but he ate no food and drank no water, because he was mourning over the unfaithfulness of the returned exiles.
en.R: Then Ezra left the front of God's temple and went to the room of Jehohanan son of Eliashib. While he was there, he did not eat any food or drink any water. He was mourning because the people who came back from exile had been unfaithful.

es.L: Y se levantó Esdras de delante de la casa de Dios y fue a la cámara de Johanán hijo de Eliasib; y fue allí; no comió pan ni bebió agua, porque estaba de duelo por la infidelidad del destierro.
es.B: Luego Esdras se retiró de delante de la casa de Dios y fue a la habitación de Johanán hijo de Eliasib. Fue allí, pero no comió nada ni bebió agua, porque estaba de duelo por la infidelidad de los que habían vuelto del destierro.
es.R: Luego Esdras se fue de delante del templo de Dios y fue a la habitación de Johanán hijo de Eliasib. Mientras estuvo allí, no comió nada ni bebió agua. Estaba de duelo porque los que regresaron del destierro habían sido infieles.

sw.L: Na Ezra akainuka kutoka mbele ya nyumba ya Mungu, akaenda kwenye chumba cha Yehohanani mwana wa Eliashibu, naye akaenda huko; hakula mkate wala hakunywa maji, kwa maana alikuwa akiomboleza kwa sababu ya uasi wa uhamisho.
sw.B: Kisha Ezra aliondoka mahali pake mbele ya nyumba ya Mungu, akaenda kwenye chumba cha Yehohanani mwana wa Eliashibu. Alikwenda huko, lakini hakula chakula wala hakunywa maji, kwa sababu alikuwa akiomboleza juu ya ukosefu wa uaminifu wa waliorudi kutoka uhamishoni.
sw.R: Kisha Ezra aliondoka mbele ya hekalu la Mungu, akaenda kwenye chumba cha Yehohanani mwana wa Eliashibu. Alipokuwa huko hakula chakula wala hakunywa maji. Alikuwa akiomboleza kwa sababu watu waliorudi kutoka uhamishoni walikuwa wamekosa uaminifu.

decisions.choice: and he went there: perhaps "and he spent the night there"
alternatives: and he spent the night there
decisions.reason: The Hebrew repeats "he went", which reads awkwardly after "went to the chamber". The Greek book called 1 Esdras, which retells this chapter, has "spent the night there" (1 Esdras 9:2); in Hebrew the two verbs differ by one letter. The received text is translated, and the other reading is noted.

decisions.choice: the chamber of Jehohanan son of Eliashib: a room in the temple buildings
decisions.reason: Rooms around the temple courts were used for storage and lodging (8:29; Nehemiah 13:4-9). A Johanan descended from the high priest Eliashib is named in Nehemiah 12:22-23; whether he is this Jehohanan is not certain, since both names were common.

decisions.choice: he ate no bread and drank no water: a complete fast in mourning
decisions.reason: Going without water as well as food is an extreme fast, like that of Moses when he pleaded for the people after the golden calf (Deuteronomy 9:18). Ezra mourns the people's sin as if for a death.

decisions.choice: chamber (Literal), room (Balanced, Readable); bread (Literal), food (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: "Bread" stands for food in general here.

decisions.choice: "habitación" (B, R), "cámara" (L); "no comió nada" (B, R), "no comió pan" (L)
decisions.reason: As the English: "bread" stands for food, and the chamber is a room in the temple buildings. Jehohanan in the usual Spanish form Johanán; Eliashib as "Eliasib", the form of 1 Chronicles 24:12.

source.text: וַיַּעֲבִ֨ירוּ ק֜וֹל בִּיהוּדָ֣ה וִירֽוּשָׁלִַ֗ם לְכֹל֙ בְּנֵ֣י הַגּוֹלָ֔ה לְהִקָּבֵ֖ץ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And they made pass a proclamation in Judah and Jerusalem to all [the] sons of the exile to gather [to] Jerusalem;

en.L: And they made a proclamation pass through Judah and Jerusalem to all the sons of the exile, to assemble [at] Jerusalem,
en.B: A proclamation was sent throughout Judah and Jerusalem to all the returned exiles that they were to assemble in Jerusalem.
en.R: Then a message was sent all over Judah and Jerusalem to all the people who came back from exile. It told them to meet together in Jerusalem.

es.L: E hicieron pregonar por Judá y Jerusalén a todos los hijos del destierro que se reunieran [en] Jerusalén,
es.B: Se envió un pregón por todo Judá y Jerusalén a todos los que habían vuelto del destierro, para que se reunieran en Jerusalén.
es.R: Entonces se envió un mensaje por todo Judá y Jerusalén a todos los que regresaron del destierro. Se les pedía que se reunieran en Jerusalén.

sw.L: Nao wakapitisha tangazo katika Yuda na Yerusalemu kwa wana wote wa uhamisho, kwamba wakusanyike Yerusalemu,
sw.B: Tangazo lilipelekwa katika Yuda yote na Yerusalemu kwa wote waliorudi kutoka uhamishoni kwamba wakusanyike Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Kisha ujumbe ulipelekwa kila mahali katika Yuda na Yerusalemu kwa watu wote waliorudi kutoka uhamishoni. Uliwaambia wakutane Yerusalemu.

decisions.choice: Judah and Jerusalem: the small Persian province around Jerusalem
decisions.reason: In Ezra's time Judah was a small province of the Persian empire, with Jerusalem at its center, so a summons could reach every town within the three days set in verse 8.

decisions.choice: the sons of the exile: the returned exiles and their families
decisions.reason: The phrase names the community as a whole, those who had come back from Babylon and their descendants (4:1; 6:19-20).

decisions.choice: the sons of the exile (Literal), the returned exiles (Balanced), the people who came back from exile (Readable)
decisions.reason: These follow the book-wide wording for this phrase.

source.text: וְכֹל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא־יָב֜וֹא לִשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת הַיָּמִ֗ים כַּעֲצַ֤ת הַשָּׂרִים֙ וְהַזְּקֵנִ֔ים יָחֳרַ֖ם כָּל־רְכוּשׁ֑וֹ וְה֥וּא יִבָּדֵ֖ל מִקְּהַ֥ל הַגּוֹלָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: and everyone who not comes within three days, according to [the] counsel of the princes and the elders, shall be devoted all his property, and he shall be separated from [the] assembly of the exile.

en.L: and everyone who did not come within three days, according to the counsel of the princes and the elders, all his property would be devoted, and he himself would be separated from the assembly of the exile.
en.B: Anyone who did not come within three days, as the leaders and elders had decided, would forfeit all his property and would himself be cut off from the assembly of the returned exiles.
en.R: The leaders and elders decided that anyone who did not come within three days would lose everything he owned. His property would be given over to God, and he would no longer belong to the community of the people who came back from exile.

es.L: y que todo el que no viniera dentro de tres días, conforme al consejo de los príncipes y de los ancianos, toda su hacienda sería dada por anatema, y él mismo sería separado de la asamblea del destierro.
es.B: Cualquiera que no viniera dentro de tres días, según lo que habían decidido los jefes y los ancianos, perdería todos sus bienes y él mismo sería excluido de la asamblea de los que habían vuelto del destierro.
es.R: Los jefes y los ancianos decidieron que cualquiera que no viniera dentro de tres días perdería todo lo que tenía. Sus bienes serían entregados a Dios, y él ya no pertenecería a la comunidad de los que regresaron del destierro.

sw.L: na kila mtu ambaye hangekuja katika siku tatu, sawasawa na shauri la wakuu na wazee, mali yake yote ingewekwa wakfu, naye mwenyewe angetengwa na kusanyiko la uhamisho.
sw.B: Yeyote ambaye hangekuja katika siku tatu, kama viongozi na wazee walivyoamua, angepoteza mali yake yote, naye mwenyewe angetengwa na kusanyiko la waliorudi kutoka uhamishoni.
sw.R: Viongozi na wazee waliamua kwamba yeyote ambaye hangekuja katika siku tatu angepoteza kila kitu alichokuwa nacho. Mali yake ingetolewa kwa Mungu, naye hangekuwa tena sehemu ya jumuiya ya watu waliorudi kutoka uhamishoni.

decisions.choice: all his property would be devoted: taken from him and given over to God
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used for things devoted to God, which could never be bought back (Leviticus 27:28). Here it means the property would be confiscated, most likely for the temple. Artaxerxes had given Ezra power to punish by confiscating goods (7:26).

decisions.choice: separated from the assembly: excluded from the community
decisions.reason: The verb is the same as in 9:1 and 10:11, where the people are to separate themselves from the peoples of the land. Anyone who refused to come would himself be separated, put out of the community of the returned exiles.

decisions.choice: devoted (Literal), forfeit (Balanced), given over to God (Readable)
decisions.reason: Elsewhere the word is rendered "devoted" or "destroyed completely", but here the property is not destroyed. Balanced says what happens to the owner; Readable says where the property goes.

decisions.choice: "sería dada por anatema" (L); "perdería" (B); "serían entregados a Dios" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb of things devoted to God (m1): Literal keeps the sense of devotion with "anatema", Balanced says what happens to the owner, Readable says where the property goes, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "ingewekwa wakfu" (L), "angepoteza" (B), "ingetolewa kwa Mungu" (R)
decisions.reason: The property is not destroyed but given over; as the English, Balanced says what happens to the owner and Readable where the property goes.

source.text: וַיִּקָּבְצ֣וּ כָל־אַנְשֵֽׁי־יְהוּדָה֩ וּבִנְיָמִ֨ן׀יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם לִשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת הַיָּמִ֗ים ה֛וּא חֹ֥דֶשׁ הַתְּשִׁיעִ֖י בְּעֶשְׂרִ֣ים בַּחֹ֑דֶשׁ וַיֵּשְׁב֣וּ כָל־הָעָ֗ם בִּרְחוֹב֙ בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים מַרְעִידִ֥ים עַל־הַדָּבָ֖ר וּמֵהַגְּשָׁמִֽים׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And assembled all [the] men of Judah and Benjamin [at] Jerusalem within three the days; it [was] the month the ninth, on [the] twentieth in the month; and sat all the people in [the] square of [the] house of God, trembling over the matter and from the rains.

en.L: And all the men of Judah and Benjamin assembled [at] Jerusalem within the three days; it [was] the ninth month, on the twentieth of the month. And all the people sat in the square of the house of God, trembling because of the matter and because of the rains.
en.B: So within the three days all the men of Judah and Benjamin assembled in Jerusalem. It was the twentieth day of the ninth month. All the people sat in the open square in front of the house of God, trembling because of this matter and because of the heavy rain.
en.R: So within three days all the men of Judah and Benjamin came together in Jerusalem. It was the twentieth day of the ninth month, in the rainy season of winter. All the people sat in the open square in front of God's temple. They were trembling because of this serious matter and shivering in the heavy rain.

es.L: Y se reunieron todos los hombres de Judá y de Benjamín [en] Jerusalén dentro de los tres días; [era] el mes noveno, a los veinte [días] del mes. Y todo el pueblo se sentó en la plaza de la casa de Dios, temblando por el asunto y por las lluvias.
es.B: Así que dentro de los tres días todos los hombres de Judá y de Benjamín se reunieron en Jerusalén. Era el día veinte del mes noveno. Todo el pueblo se sentó en la plaza delante de la casa de Dios, temblando por este asunto y por la fuerte lluvia.
es.R: Así que dentro de tres días todos los hombres de Judá y de Benjamín se reunieron en Jerusalén. Era el día veinte del mes noveno, en la temporada de lluvias del invierno. Todo el pueblo se sentó en la plaza delante del templo de Dios. Temblaban por este asunto tan grave y tiritaban bajo la fuerte lluvia.

sw.L: Ndipo wanaume wote wa Yuda na Benyamini wakakusanyika Yerusalemu katika zile siku tatu; ulikuwa mwezi wa tisa, siku ya ishirini ya mwezi. Na watu wote wakaketi katika uwanja wa nyumba ya Mungu, wakitetemeka kwa sababu ya jambo hilo na kwa sababu ya mvua.
sw.B: Hivyo katika siku hizo tatu wanaume wote wa Yuda na Benyamini walikusanyika Yerusalemu. Ilikuwa siku ya ishirini ya mwezi wa tisa. Watu wote waliketi katika uwanja mbele ya nyumba ya Mungu, wakitetemeka kwa sababu ya jambo hilo na kwa sababu ya mvua kubwa.
sw.R: Hivyo katika siku tatu wanaume wote wa Yuda na Benyamini walikusanyika Yerusalemu. Ilikuwa siku ya ishirini ya mwezi wa tisa, wakati wa mvua za baridi. Watu wote waliketi katika uwanja mbele ya hekalu la Mungu. Walikuwa wakitetemeka kwa hofu kwa sababu ya jambo hilo zito, na kwa baridi ya mvua kubwa.

decisions.choice: the twentieth day of the ninth month: in early winter, the rainy season
decisions.reason: The ninth month (Kislev) falls in November and December, when the winter rains come and it is cold in Jerusalem (Jeremiah 36:22). Ezra had arrived in the fifth month (7:9), so this is more than four months later.

decisions.choice: Judah and Benjamin: the tribes of the returned community
decisions.reason: Those who returned from exile came mostly from the tribes of Judah and Benjamin (1:5; 4:1).

decisions.choice: trembling because of the matter and the rains: fear and cold together
decisions.reason: The people tremble from fear over what they have done and what may follow, and from the cold rain falling on them as they sit in the open.

decisions.choice: in the rainy season of winter; trembling ... and shivering (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable gives the season, which the month implies (verse 13), and uses two verbs for the one Hebrew word, since fear and cold are two different causes.

source.text: וַיָּ֨קָם עֶזְרָ֤א הַכֹּהֵן֙ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֔ם אַתֶּ֣ם מְעַלְתֶּ֔ם וַתֹּשִׁ֖יבוּ נָשִׁ֣ים נָכְרִיּ֑וֹת לְהוֹסִ֖יף עַל־אַשְׁמַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And arose Ezra the priest and said to them, You, you have acted unfaithfully and have settled women foreign, to add to [the] guilt of Israel.

en.L: And Ezra the priest arose and said to them, "You have been unfaithful and have married foreign women, to add to the guilt of Israel.
en.B: Then Ezra the priest stood up and said to them, "You have been unfaithful by marrying foreign wives, and so you have added to Israel's guilt.
en.R: Then Ezra the priest stood up and spoke to them. He said, "You have been unfaithful to God. You married foreign wives and made Israel even more guilty.

es.L: Y se levantó Esdras el sacerdote y les dijo: «{{plural_you:Ustedes han sido infieles y han tomado|Vosotros habéis sido infieles y habéis tomado}} mujeres extranjeras, para aumentar la culpa de Israel.
es.B: Entonces el sacerdote Esdras se puso de pie y les dijo: «{{plural_you:Ustedes han sido infieles al casarse|Vosotros habéis sido infieles al casaros}} con esposas extranjeras, y así {{plural_you:han aumentado|habéis aumentado}} la culpa de Israel.
es.R: Entonces el sacerdote Esdras se puso de pie y les habló. Les dijo: «{{plural_you:Ustedes han sido infieles|Vosotros habéis sido infieles}} a Dios. {{plural_you:Se casaron|Os casasteis}} con esposas extranjeras e {{plural_you:hicieron|hicisteis}} que Israel fuera todavía más culpable.

sw.L: Ndipo Ezra kuhani akainuka, akawaambia, "Ninyi mmeasi, mmeoa wanawake wageni, na kuiongeza hatia ya Israeli.
sw.B: Kisha Ezra kuhani alisimama, akawaambia, "Mmekosa uaminifu kwa kuoa wake wageni, na hivyo mmeiongeza hatia ya Israeli.
sw.R: Kisha Ezra kuhani alisimama, akasema nao. Aliwaambia, "Mmekosa uaminifu kwa Mungu. Mmeoa wake wageni na kuifanya Israeli kuwa na hatia zaidi.

decisions.choice: to add to the guilt of Israel: the guilt already weighing on the people
decisions.reason: Ezra's prayer spoke of guilt piled up since the days of the ancestors (9:6-7, 13). The marriages add more to it.

decisions.choice: you have been unfaithful: the same word as in 9:2, 4 and 10:2
decisions.reason: The charge uses the key word of these chapters, a breach of trust against God.

decisions.choice: unfaithful to God (Readable)
decisions.reason: The unfaithfulness is against God (10:2); Readable says so.

decisions.choice: plural_you for Ezra's words to the assembly (verses 10-11)
decisions.reason: Ezra speaks to the whole assembly, so every "you" is the plural setting, with the verb forms inside the span.

source.text: וְעַתָּ֗ה תְּנ֥וּ תוֹדָ֛ה לַיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי־אֲבֹתֵיכֶ֖ם וַעֲשׂ֣וּ רְצוֹנ֑וֹ וְהִבָּֽדְלוּ֙ מֵעַמֵּ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ וּמִן־הַנָּשִׁ֖ים הַנָּכְרִיּֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And now give confession to YHWH, [the] God of your fathers, and do his will, and separate yourselves from [the] peoples of the land and from the women foreign.

en.L: And now make confession to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of your fathers, and do {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} will, and separate yourselves from the peoples of the land and from the foreign women."
en.B: Now make confession to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of your ancestors, and do {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} will. Separate yourselves from the peoples of the land and from your foreign wives."
en.R: Now confess your sin to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of your ancestors, and do what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} wants. Separate yourselves from the people living in the land and from your foreign wives."

es.L: Ahora, pues, {{plural_you:hagan|haced}} confesión {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, el Dios de {{plural_you:sus padres|vuestros padres}}, y {{plural_you:hagan|haced}} {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} voluntad, y {{plural_you:sepárense|separaos}} de los pueblos de la tierra y de las mujeres extranjeras».
es.B: Ahora {{plural_you:hagan|haced}} confesión {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, el Dios de {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}}, y {{plural_you:hagan|haced}} {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} voluntad. {{plural_you:Sepárense|Separaos}} de los pueblos de la tierra y de {{plural_you:sus esposas extranjeras|vuestras esposas extranjeras}}».
es.R: Ahora {{plural_you:confiesen|confesad}} {{plural_you:su pecado|vuestro pecado}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, el Dios de {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}}, y {{plural_you:hagan|haced}} lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} quiere. {{plural_you:Sepárense|Separaos}} de la gente que vive en el país y de {{plural_you:sus esposas extranjeras|vuestras esposas extranjeras}}».

sw.L: Basi sasa ungameni kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa baba zenu, mkafanye mapenzi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, mjitenge na mataifa ya nchi na wanawake wageni."
sw.B: Basi sasa ungameni kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa wazee wenu, mkafanye mapenzi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. Jitengeni na mataifa ya nchi na wake zenu wageni."
sw.R: Sasa ungameni dhambi yenu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa wazee wenu, mkafanye mapenzi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. Jitengeni na watu walioishi katika nchi na wake zenu wageni."

decisions.choice: give confession: acknowledge your sin before God
decisions.reason: The word often means thanks or praise, but with "give" it can mean to confess, giving God his due by admitting the wrong, as Joshua told Achan to do (Joshua 7:19).

decisions.choice: separate yourselves: the step the people had failed to take
decisions.reason: The leaders' complaint in 9:1 was that the people had not separated themselves from the peoples of the land. Ezra now calls on them to do it.

source.text: וַיַּֽעְנ֧וּ כָֽל־הַקָּהָ֛ל וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ ק֣וֹל גָּד֑וֹל כֵּ֛ן כִּדְבָרְךָ֥ עָלֵ֖ינוּ לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And answered all the assembly and said [with a] voice great, So! According to your word [it is] upon us to do.

en.L: And all the assembly answered and said with a loud voice, "So [it is]! According to your word, [it is] upon us to do.
en.B: The whole assembly answered with a loud voice, "Yes! We must do as you have said.
en.R: All the people answered with a loud voice, "Yes! You are right. We must do what you said.

es.L: Y respondió toda la asamblea y dijo en alta voz: «¡Así [es]! Conforme a tu palabra, a nosotros [nos toca] hacer.
es.B: Toda la asamblea respondió en voz alta: «¡Sí! Debemos hacer lo que has dicho.
es.R: Todo el pueblo respondió en voz alta: «¡Sí! Tienes razón. Debemos hacer lo que dijiste.

sw.L: Na kusanyiko lote likajibu, likasema kwa sauti kuu, "Ndivyo! Sawasawa na neno lako, [ni] juu yetu kufanya.
sw.B: Kusanyiko lote lilijibu kwa sauti kuu, "Ndiyo! Ni lazima tufanye kama ulivyosema.
sw.R: Watu wote walijibu kwa sauti kuu, "Ndiyo! Uko sahihi. Ni lazima tufanye ulichosema.

decisions.choice: your word: the reading the scribes marked
decisions.reason: The consonants written in the text (ketiv) read "your words"; the reading the scribes marked (qere) is "your word". The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: upon us to do: it is our duty to do it
decisions.reason: "It is on us" means it is our responsibility, as "the matter is on you" did for Ezra in verse 4. The people accept the duty, then raise the practical difficulty in verse 13.

source.text: אֲבָ֞ל הָעָ֥ם רָב֙ וְהָעֵ֣ת גְּשָׁמִ֔ים וְאֵ֥ין כֹּ֖חַ לַעֲמ֣וֹד בַּח֑וּץ וְהַמְּלָאכָ֗ה לֹֽא־לְי֤וֹם אֶחָד֙ וְלֹ֣א לִשְׁנַ֔יִם כִּֽי־הִרְבִּ֥ינוּ לִפְשֹׁ֖עַ בַּדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: But the people [are] many, and the time [is] rains, and there is no strength to stand outside; and the work not for day one and not for two, for we have multiplied to transgress in the matter this.

en.L: But the people [are] many, and it [is] the season of rains, and there is no strength to stand outside; and the work [is] not for one day or for two, for we have greatly transgressed in this matter.
en.B: But there are many people here, and it is the rainy season; we cannot stand out in the open. Besides, this is not a task for one or two days, because many of us have sinned seriously in this matter.
en.R: But there are so many people, and it is the rainy season. We cannot keep standing out here in the rain. And this cannot be done in one or two days, because so many of us have sinned in this way.

es.L: Pero el pueblo [es] mucho, y [es] tiempo de lluvias, y no hay fuerza para estar afuera; y la obra no [es] de un día ni de dos, porque hemos pecado mucho en este asunto.
es.B: Pero aquí hay mucha gente, y es la temporada de lluvias; no podemos quedarnos afuera. Además, esta no es tarea de uno o dos días, porque muchos de nosotros hemos pecado gravemente en este asunto.
es.R: Pero somos muchísimos, y es la temporada de lluvias. No podemos seguir aquí afuera bajo la lluvia. Y esto no se puede hacer en uno o dos días, porque muchos de nosotros hemos pecado de esta manera.

sw.L: Lakini watu [ni] wengi, nao [ni] wakati wa mvua, wala hakuna nguvu ya kusimama nje; na kazi hii [si] ya siku moja wala ya mbili, kwa maana tumekosa sana katika jambo hili.
sw.B: Lakini watu ni wengi hapa, na ni wakati wa masika; hatuwezi kusimama nje. Tena kazi hii si ya siku moja wala mbili, kwa sababu wengi wetu tumetenda dhambi kubwa katika jambo hili.
sw.R: Lakini watu ni wengi sana, na ni wakati wa mvua. Hatuwezi kuendelea kusimama hapa nje kwenye mvua. Tena jambo hili haliwezi kumalizwa kwa siku moja au mbili, kwa sababu wengi sana wetu wametenda dhambi hii.

decisions.choice: we have multiplied to transgress: many of us have sinned, and the sin is great
decisions.reason: The verb "multiply" with "to transgress" can mean that the sin was great, or that many committed it. The reason given (the work will take more than a day or two) points to the number of cases; both are true.

decisions.choice: transgress: rebel, break faith
decisions.reason: The verb means to rebel against an authority or to break an agreement. It is a strong word for sin, set beside "unfaithfulness" in verse 10.

decisions.choice: greatly transgressed (Literal), many of us have sinned seriously (Balanced), so many of us have sinned (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps both senses of the verb; Readable gives the one that explains why the work will take long.

source.text: יַֽעֲמְדוּ־נָ֣א שָׂ֠רֵינוּ לְֽכָל־הַקָּהָ֞ל וְכֹ֣ל׀אֲשֶׁ֣ר בֶּעָרֵ֗ינוּ הַהֹשִׁ֞יב נָשִׁ֤ים נָכְרִיּוֹת֙ יָבֹא֙ לְעִתִּ֣ים מְזֻמָּנִ֔ים וְעִמָּהֶ֛ם זִקְנֵי־עִ֥יר וָעִ֖יר וְשֹׁפְטֶ֑יהָ עַ֠ד לְהָשִׁ֞יב חֲר֤וֹן אַף־אֱלֹהֵ֨ינוּ֙ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ עַ֖ד לַדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: Let stand please our princes for all the assembly, and all who [are] in our cities who has settled women foreign, let him come at times appointed, and with them [the] elders of city and city and its judges, until turning back [the] burning of [the] anger of our God from us, until for the matter this.

en.L: Let our princes stand for the whole assembly, and let all who are in our cities who have married foreign women come at appointed times, and with them the elders and judges of each city, until the burning anger of our God is turned back from us over this matter."
en.B: Let our leaders act for the whole assembly. Let everyone in our towns who has married a foreign wife come at a set time, together with the elders and judges of each town, until the fierce anger of our God over this matter is turned away from us."
en.R: Let our leaders act for all the people here. Then let every man in our towns who has married a foreign wife come at a time that is set for him. The elders and judges of his town should come with him. We must do this until our God is no longer angry with us about this."

es.L: Que se pongan nuestros príncipes en lugar de toda la asamblea, y que todos los que en nuestras ciudades han tomado mujeres extranjeras vengan en tiempos señalados, y con ellos los ancianos de cada ciudad y sus jueces, hasta que se aparte de nosotros el ardor de la ira de nuestro Dios por este asunto».
es.B: Que nuestros jefes actúen en nombre de toda la asamblea. Que todos los de nuestras ciudades que se hayan casado con esposas extranjeras vengan en una fecha fijada, junto con los ancianos y los jueces de cada ciudad, hasta que se aparte de nosotros la ardiente ira de nuestro Dios por este asunto».
es.R: Que nuestros jefes actúen en nombre de todo el pueblo aquí reunido. Luego, que cada hombre de nuestras ciudades que se haya casado con una esposa extranjera venga en la fecha que se le fije. Que vengan con él los ancianos y los jueces de su ciudad. Debemos hacer esto hasta que nuestro Dios ya no esté enojado con nosotros por este asunto».

sw.L: Wakuu wetu na wasimame kwa ajili ya kusanyiko lote, na wote walio katika miji yetu waliooa wanawake wageni waje kwa nyakati zilizowekwa, na pamoja nao wazee na waamuzi wa kila mji, mpaka hasira kali ya Mungu wetu igeuzwe mbali nasi kwa ajili ya jambo hili."
sw.B: Viongozi wetu na wasimame kwa niaba ya kusanyiko lote. Kila mtu katika miji yetu aliyeoa mke mgeni aje kwa wakati uliowekwa, pamoja na wazee na waamuzi wa kila mji, mpaka hasira kali ya Mungu wetu juu ya jambo hili igeuzwe mbali nasi."
sw.R: Viongozi wetu na washughulikie jambo hili kwa niaba ya watu wote hapa. Kisha kila mwanamume katika miji yetu aliyeoa mke mgeni aje kwa wakati atakaopangiwa. Wazee na waamuzi wa mji wake waje pamoja naye. Ni lazima tufanye hivyo mpaka Mungu wetu asitukasirikie tena kwa ajili ya jambo hili."

decisions.choice: let our princes stand for the whole assembly: let the leaders act on behalf of everyone
decisions.reason: Instead of the whole people standing in the rain, the leaders are to represent them and oversee the cases.

decisions.choice: the elders of city and city and its judges: the elders and judges of each town
decisions.reason: Repeating a noun means "each". The local elders and judges knew the families and could confirm the facts of each case, as Ezra had been told to appoint judges (7:25).

decisions.choice: the burning of the anger of our God: God's fierce anger
decisions.reason: "Burning of anger" is a strong phrase for wrath (Numbers 25:4; 2 Chronicles 29:10). The leaders fear what Ezra feared in 9:14.

decisions.choice: until, concerning this matter: the last words are compressed
alternatives: until this matter is dealt with
decisions.reason: The Hebrew ends with "until for this matter", which most likely ties God's anger to this matter ("over this matter"). It can also be read as a second time limit, "until this matter is settled". Either way the sense of the plan is clear.

decisions.choice: princes (Literal), leaders (Balanced, Readable); towns (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 9:1-2. The places meant are the towns and villages of Judah, so Balanced and Readable say "towns".

source.text: אַ֣ךְ יוֹנָתָ֧ן בֶּן־עֲשָׂהאֵ֛ל וְיַחְזְיָ֥ה בֶן־תִּקְוָ֖ה עָמְד֣וּ עַל־זֹ֑את וּמְשֻׁלָּ֛ם וְשַׁבְּתַ֥י הַלֵּוִ֖י עֲזָרֻֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Only Jonathan son of Asahel and Jahzeiah son of Tikvah stood against this, and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite helped them.

en.L: Only Jonathan son of Asahel and Jahzeiah son of Tikvah stood against this, and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite supported them.
en.B: Only Jonathan son of Asahel and Jahzeiah son of Tikvah opposed this, and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite supported them.
en.R: Only Jonathan son of Asahel and Jahzeiah son of Tikvah were against this plan, and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite took their side.

es.L: Solo Jonatán hijo de Asael y Jahazías hijo de Ticva se opusieron a esto, y Mesulam y Sabetai el levita los apoyaron.
es.B: Solo Jonatán hijo de Asael y Jahazías hijo de Ticva se opusieron a esto, y Mesulam y Sabetai el levita los apoyaron.
es.R: Solo Jonatán hijo de Asael y Jahazías hijo de Ticva estuvieron en contra de este plan, y Mesulam y Sabetai el levita se pusieron de su lado.

sw.L: Ni Yonathani mwana wa Asaheli tu na Yahzeya mwana wa Tikva waliosimama dhidi ya jambo hili, na Meshulamu na Shabethai Mlawi wakawaunga mkono.
sw.B: Ni Yonathani mwana wa Asaheli na Yahzeya mwana wa Tikva peke yao waliopinga jambo hili, na Meshulamu na Shabethai Mlawi wakawaunga mkono.
sw.R: Ni Yonathani mwana wa Asaheli na Yahzeya mwana wa Tikva peke yao waliopinga mpango huu, na Meshulamu na Shabethai Mlawi wakawa upande wao.

decisions.choice: stood against this: opposed the plan
decisions.reason: "Stood against" usually means to oppose (Daniel 8:25; 11:14), and "only" fits a small group who disagreed. The words can also mean "stood over this", that is, were put in charge of it, and some have read it that way. The text does not say why they objected, or whether to the plan itself or to the delay.

decisions.choice: supported them: helped them, took their side
decisions.reason: The verb means to help. If the first two men opposed the plan, Meshullam and Shabbethai backed their objection.

source.text: וַיַּֽעֲשׂוּ־כֵן֮ בְּנֵ֣י הַגּוֹלָה֒ וַיִּבָּדְלוּ֩ עֶזְרָ֨א הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֲנָשִׁ֨ים רָאשֵׁ֧י הָאָב֛וֹת לְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתָ֖ם וְכֻלָּ֣ם בְּשֵׁמ֑וֹת וַיֵּשְׁב֗וּ בְּי֤וֹם אֶחָד֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָעֲשִׂירִ֔י לְדַרְי֖וֹשׁ הַדָּבָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And did so [the] sons of the exile; and were set apart Ezra the priest, men, heads of the fathers, for [the] house of their fathers, and all of them by names; and they sat on day one of the month the tenth to examine the matter.

en.L: And the sons of the exile did so. And Ezra the priest [and] men, heads of the fathers, by their fathers' houses, all of them by name, were set apart; and they sat down on the first day of the tenth month to examine the matter.
en.B: So the returned exiles did as they had proposed. Ezra the priest and certain heads of families, one for each family and all of them named, were set apart for the task. On the first day of the tenth month they sat down to investigate the matter.
en.R: So the people who came back from exile did what had been planned. Ezra the priest and some heads of families were chosen for this work, one for each family, and each one was named. On the first day of the tenth month they sat down to look into each case.

es.L: E hicieron así los hijos del destierro. Y fueron apartados Esdras el sacerdote [y] hombres, jefes de las [casas] paternas, según sus casas paternas, todos ellos por nombre; y se sentaron el primer día del mes décimo para examinar el asunto.
es.B: Así que los que habían vuelto del destierro hicieron lo que se había propuesto. El sacerdote Esdras y algunos jefes de familia, uno por cada familia y todos ellos nombrados, fueron apartados para esta tarea. El primer día del mes décimo se sentaron a investigar el asunto.
es.R: Así que los que regresaron del destierro hicieron lo que se había planeado. El sacerdote Esdras y algunos jefes de familia fueron escogidos para este trabajo, uno por cada familia, y cada uno fue nombrado. El primer día del mes décimo se sentaron a examinar cada caso.

sw.L: Na wana wa uhamisho wakafanya hivyo. Na Ezra kuhani [na] watu, wakuu wa baba, kwa nyumba za baba zao, wote kwa majina, wakatengwa; nao wakaketi siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa kumi kulichunguza jambo hilo.
sw.B: Hivyo waliorudi kutoka uhamishoni walifanya kama ilivyopendekezwa. Ezra kuhani na baadhi ya wakuu wa jamaa, mmoja kwa kila jamaa, wote wakitajwa kwa majina, walitengwa kwa kazi hiyo. Siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa kumi waliketi kulichunguza jambo hilo.
sw.R: Hivyo watu waliorudi kutoka uhamishoni walifanya kama ilivyopangwa. Ezra kuhani na baadhi ya wakuu wa jamaa walichaguliwa kwa kazi hii, mmoja kwa kila jamaa, na kila mmoja alitajwa kwa jina. Siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa kumi waliketi kuchunguza kila shauri.

decisions.choice: were set apart, Ezra ... men: perhaps "Ezra set apart for himself men"
alternatives: Ezra the priest set apart men who were heads of families
decisions.reason: The Hebrew reads awkwardly: a plural passive verb with "Ezra the priest, men, heads of families". 1 Esdras 9:16 has "Ezra chose for himself men", which a small change in the Hebrew letters would also give. Either way Ezra and the family heads together form the panel that hears the cases.

decisions.choice: to examine: to investigate each case
decisions.reason: The verb means to seek or inquire, here in the sense of a careful inquiry. It is spelled in an unusual way that looks like the name Darius; the meaning is not in doubt.

decisions.choice: the first day of the tenth month: ten days after the assembly
decisions.reason: The assembly met on the twentieth day of the ninth month (verse 9), so the panel began its work ten days later, in midwinter.

decisions.choice: heads of the fathers, fathers' houses (Literal); heads of families, family (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: These follow the wording used for the ancestral family across the Old Testament books.

source.text: וַיְכַלּ֣וּ בַכֹּ֔ל אֲנָשִׁ֕ים הַהֹשִׁ֖יבוּ נָשִׁ֣ים נָכְרִיּ֑וֹת עַ֛ד י֥וֹם אֶחָ֖ד לַחֹ֥דֶשׁ הָרִאשֽׁוֹן׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And they finished with all, [the] men who had settled women foreign, by day one of the month the first.

en.L: And they finished with all the men who had married foreign women by the first day of the first month.
en.B: By the first day of the first month they had finished dealing with all the men who had married foreign wives.
en.R: By the first day of the first month of the next year, they had finished with all the cases of men who had married foreign wives.

es.L: Y terminaron con todos los hombres que habían tomado mujeres extranjeras para el primer día del mes primero.
es.B: Para el primer día del mes primero habían terminado de tratar los casos de todos los hombres que se habían casado con esposas extranjeras.
es.R: Para el primer día del mes primero del año siguiente, ya habían terminado con todos los casos de hombres que se habían casado con esposas extranjeras.

sw.L: Nao wakamaliza [shauri la] wanaume wote waliooa wanawake wageni kufikia siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa kwanza.
sw.B: Kufikia siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa kwanza walikuwa wamemaliza mashauri ya wanaume wote waliooa wake wageni.
sw.R: Kufikia siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa kwanza wa mwaka uliofuata, walikuwa wamemaliza mashauri yote ya wanaume waliooa wake wageni.

decisions.choice: the first day of the first month: three months later, a year after Ezra set out
decisions.reason: The inquiry ran from the first day of the tenth month to the first day of the first month of the next year. Ezra had left Babylon on the first day of the first month (7:9), so the work ends a year to the day after his journey began.

decisions.choice: they finished with all: they completed their inquiry into every case
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "with all, the men", meaning everything concerning the men. It says that the inquiry was completed; what followed for each household is told only in verses 19 and 44.

decisions.choice: of the next year (Readable)
decisions.reason: The first month comes after the tenth, so it belongs to the following year; Readable says so.

source.text: וַיִּמָּצֵא֙ מִבְּנֵ֣י הַכֹּהֲנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֹשִׁ֖יבוּ נָשִׁ֣ים נָכְרִיּ֑וֹת מִבְּנֵ֨ייֵשׁ֤וּעַ בֶּן־יֽוֹצָדָק֙ וְאֶחָ֔יו מַֽעֲשֵׂיָה֙ וֶֽאֱלִיעֶ֔זֶר וְיָרִ֖יב וּגְדַלְיָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And was found of [the] sons of the priests who had settled women foreign: of [the] sons of Jeshua son of Jozadak and his brothers, Maaseiah and Eliezer and Jarib and Gedaliah.

en.L: And there were found among the sons of the priests [some] who had married foreign women: of the sons of Jeshua son of Jozadak and his brothers, Maaseiah and Eliezer and Jarib and Gedaliah.
en.B: These were found to have married foreign wives. From the priests: of the descendants of Jeshua son of Jozadak and his brothers, Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib, and Gedaliah.
en.R: These are the men who were found to have married foreign wives. From the priests' families, from the family of Jeshua son of Jozadak and his relatives, there were Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib, and Gedaliah.

es.L: Y entre los hijos de los sacerdotes se hallaron [algunos] que habían tomado mujeres extranjeras: de los hijos de Jesúa hijo de Josadac y de sus hermanos, Maasías y Eliezer y Jarib y Gedalías.
es.B: Se encontró que estos se habían casado con esposas extranjeras. De los sacerdotes: de los descendientes de Jesúa hijo de Josadac y de sus hermanos, Maasías, Eliezer, Jarib y Gedalías.
es.R: Estos son los hombres que se encontró que se habían casado con esposas extranjeras. De las familias de los sacerdotes, de la familia de Jesúa hijo de Josadac y de sus parientes, estaban Maasías, Eliezer, Jarib y Gedalías.

sw.L: Na miongoni mwa wana wa makuhani wakaonekana [wengine] waliooa wanawake wageni: wa wana wa Yeshua mwana wa Yosadaki na ndugu zake, Maaseya na Eliezeri na Yaribu na Gedalia.
sw.B: Hawa ndio walioonekana kuwa wameoa wake wageni. Katika makuhani: wa wazao wa Yeshua mwana wa Yosadaki na ndugu zake, Maaseya, Eliezeri, Yaribu na Gedalia.
sw.R: Hawa ndio wanaume walioonekana kuwa wameoa wake wageni. Katika jamaa za makuhani, kutoka jamaa ya Yeshua mwana wa Yosadaki na ndugu zake, walikuwa Maaseya, Eliezeri, Yaribu na Gedalia.

decisions.choice: the list begins with the priests, and with the high priest's own family
decisions.reason: Jeshua son of Jozadak was the high priest who led the first return with Zerubbabel and rebuilt the altar (3:2; 5:2; Haggai 1:1). His descendants head the list, which then runs through the priests, the Levites, the singers and gatekeepers, and the people, in the order of the list of returned exiles in chapter 2.

decisions.choice: his brothers: his relatives, his fellow priests
decisions.reason: "Brothers" here means the kinsmen of Jeshua's house, not only his brothers by birth.

decisions.choice: the sons of (Literal), the descendants of (Balanced), the family of (Readable)
decisions.reason: The book-wide wording for family names in the lists, used through verse 43.

decisions.choice: "los hijos de" (L); "los descendientes de" (B); "la familia de" (R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide wording for family names in the lists, used through verse 43; names in their published Spanish forms (1 and 2 Chronicles).

decisions.choice: "wa wana wa" (L), "wa wazao wa" (B), "kutoka jamaa ya" (R) through verse 43
decisions.reason: The list wording of chapters 2 and 8, as the English.

source.text: וַיִּתְּנ֥וּ יָדָ֖ם לְהוֹצִ֣יא נְשֵׁיהֶ֑ם וַאֲשֵׁמִ֥ים אֵֽיל־צֹ֖אן עַל־אַשְׁמָתָֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And they gave their hand to send out their wives, and guilty, a ram of [the] flock for their guilt.

en.L: And they gave their hand to send away their wives, and [being] guilty, [they offered] a ram of the flock for their guilt.
en.B: They pledged themselves to send away their wives, and because they were guilty they offered a ram from the flock as a guilt offering.
en.R: They promised to send away their wives. Because they were guilty, they brought a ram from the flock as an offering to take away their guilt.

es.L: Y dieron su mano para despedir a sus mujeres, y [siendo] culpables, [ofrecieron] un carnero del rebaño por su culpa.
es.B: Se comprometieron a despedir a sus esposas, y como eran culpables, ofrecieron un carnero del rebaño como ofrenda por la culpa.
es.R: Prometieron despedir a sus esposas. Como eran culpables, llevaron un carnero del rebaño como ofrenda para quitar su culpa.

sw.L: Nao wakatoa mkono wao kwamba watawaondoa wake zao, na [wakiwa] na hatia, [wakatoa] kondoo dume wa kundi kwa ajili ya hatia yao.
sw.B: Waliahidi kwa kupeana mikono kwamba watawaondoa wake zao, na kwa kuwa walikuwa na hatia walitoa kondoo dume kutoka kundini kuwa sadaka ya hatia.
sw.R: Waliahidi kuwaondoa wake zao. Kwa kuwa walikuwa na hatia, walileta kondoo dume kutoka kundini kuwa sadaka ya kuondoa hatia yao.

decisions.choice: they gave their hand: they pledged themselves
decisions.reason: Giving the hand was the gesture of a binding promise (2 Kings 10:15; 1 Chronicles 29:24).

decisions.choice: a ram for their guilt: the guilt offering the law required for unfaithfulness
decisions.reason: The law required a ram as a guilt offering from one who had been unfaithful in what belonged to God (Leviticus 5:14-19). The word for unfaithfulness there is the one used in 9:2 and 10:2.

decisions.choice: and guilty, a ram: a short phrase with no verb
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is compressed: "and guilty, a ram of the flock for their guilt". The verb "offered" is understood. It most likely applies to the priests just named; whether the others did the same is not said.

decisions.choice: [they offered] (Literal), they offered, they brought (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The verb is supplied to make an English sentence.

decisions.choice: "se comprometieron" (B); "prometieron" (R); "dieron su mano" (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the gesture of a binding promise; Balanced and Readable say what it means (m1).

decisions.choice: "waliahidi kwa kupeana mikono" (B); Literal "wakatoa mkono wao"; Readable "waliahidi"
decisions.reason: Giving the hand is a pledge; Balanced keeps the gesture and says what it meant.

en.R: From the family of Immer: Hanani and Zebadiah.

es.B: De los descendientes de Imer: Hananí y Zebadías.
es.R: De la familia de Imer: Hananí y Zebadías.

sw.L: Na wa wana wa Imeri, Hanani na Zebadia.
sw.B: Wa wazao wa Imeri: Hanani na Zebadia.
sw.R: Kutoka jamaa ya Imeri: Hanani na Zebadia.

decisions.choice: Immer, Harim, Pashhur: the other priestly families of the return
decisions.reason: The list of returned exiles names four priestly families: Jedaiah of the house of Jeshua, Immer, Pashhur and Harim (2:36-39). All four appear here (verses 18-22).

es.R: De la familia de Harim: Maasías, Elías, Semaías, Jehiel y Uzías.

decisions.choice: Harim: a priestly family
decisions.reason: Harim is one of the priestly families of 2:39. A lay family of the same name follows in verse 31 (compare 2:32).

sw.B: Wa wazao wa Pashuri: Elioenai, Maaseya, Ishmaeli, Nethaneli, Yozabadi na Eleasa.
sw.R: Kutoka jamaa ya Pashuri: Elioenai, Maaseya, Ishmaeli, Nethaneli, Yozabadi na Eleasa.

decisions.choice: Pashhur: the largest priestly family of the return
decisions.reason: Pashhur's descendants numbered 1,247 in the list of 2:38. With this verse the priests in the list number seventeen.

source.text: וּמִֽן־הַלְוִיִּ֑ם יוֹזָבָ֣ד וְשִׁמְעִ֗י וְקֵֽלָיָה֙ ה֣וּא קְלִיטָ֔א פְּתַֽחְיָ֥ה יְהוּדָ֖ה וֶאֱלִיעֶֽזֶר׃ס

decisions.choice: they had taken: the reading the scribes marked
decisions.reason: The consonants written in the text (ketiv) give an unusual form of the verb; the reading the scribes marked (qere) is the ordinary "they had taken". The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: some had wives by whom they had children: the last clause is difficult
alternatives: and they sent them away with their children (1 Esdras 9:36)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew reads, word for word, "and there were among them women, and they had set sons", which does not give a smooth sense; the verb "set" is not used elsewhere for having children. The translation takes it to mean that some of the marriages had produced children. The Greek retelling in 1 Esdras 9:36 ends instead "and they sent them away with their children", which may reflect a different Hebrew text. The received text is translated, and the other reading is noted.

decisions.choice: the book ends with the list
decisions.reason: The book of Ezra ends here, with the names of some 110 men and no account of what became of their households. The list holds the community's leaders and priests to account by name. The same problem returns a generation later (Nehemiah 13:23-27).

decisions.choice: children or sons (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The word for sons is also the ordinary word for children, and the families surely had daughters too, so Balanced and Readable offer "children" as the default. Literal keeps "sons".

decisions.choice: "hijos", no gender setting
decisions.reason: Spanish "hijos" already means children, sons and daughters, so the English gender setting has no Spanish counterpart (terms note).

decisions.choice: "watoto" (B, R) with no gender span; Literal "wana"
decisions.reason: Swahili "watoto" covers sons and daughters, so the inclusive word stands without a setting, as in 9:12.
